CFG-LICENSING-STD-SYSTEM-SETTINGS.title: System settings
CFG-LICENSING-STD-SYSTEM-SETTINGS.steps: Configure and validate for Licensing. Sign-in methods, password/lockout rules, sessions and account behavior.
CFG-LICENSING-STD-SYSTEM-SETTINGS.applicabilityEvidence: Included in the module setup started by Brandon Dyches, Jessica Fertel. Review and exclude if unused.

CFG-LICENSING-STD-TIME-ZONE.title: Time zone
CFG-LICENSING-STD-TIME-ZONE.steps: Configure and validate for Licensing. Find the Time Zone setting in Control Center > Settings > Configurations (/Settings/Configurations). Agree the client time zone; select the matching value. Check a representative date/time in this module, including daylight-saving behavior where relevant. Complete when the agreed zone and displayed times have been checked.
CFG-LICENSING-STD-TIME-ZONE.applicabilityEvidence: Included in the module setup started by Brandon Dyches, Jessica Fertel. Review and exclude if unused.

CFG-LICENSING-STD-SUPPORTED-LANGUAGES.title: Supported languages
CFG-LICENSING-STD-SUPPORTED-LANGUAGES.steps: Configure and validate for Licensing. In Control Center > Settings > Configurations (/Settings/Configurations), find Multi-Language Support. Agree which supported languages the client will offer and configure the language selection. Check language selection and representative screens in this module. Translation content is managed under Branding, public content and vocabulary. Mark Not applicable if this module does not use this setting.
CFG-LICENSING-STD-SUPPORTED-LANGUAGES.applicabilityEvidence: Included in the module setup started by Brandon Dyches, Jessica Fertel. Review and exclude if unused.

CFG-LICENSING-STD-CUSTOMER-IDENTIFICATIO.title: Customer identification and search
CFG-LICENSING-STD-CUSTOMER-IDENTIFICATIO.steps: Configure and validate for Licensing. In Control Center > Settings > Configurations (/Settings/Configurations), review customer number algorithm, zero-padded length, profile retrieval/search options and default customer search type where used. Agree the customer identifier format and permitted search methods; check a new customer number and representative existing-customer searches in this module. These are identification/search rules, separate from customer profile field visibility. Mark Not applicable for options unavailable or unused in this module.
CFG-LICENSING-STD-CUSTOMER-IDENTIFICATIO.applicabilityEvidence: Included in the module setup started by Brandon Dyches, Jessica Fertel. Review and exclude if unused.

CFG-LICENSING-STD-PROFILE-UPDATE-FREQUEN.title: Customer profile update frequency
CFG-LICENSING-STD-PROFILE-UPDATE-FREQUEN.steps: Configure and validate for Licensing. In Control Center > Settings > Configurations (/Settings/Configurations), review the profile update frequency setting. Agree when customers must review/update their profile. Test a customer who is due for review and one who is not in this module. Complete after the expected prompt behavior is checked; mark Not applicable if unused.
CFG-LICENSING-STD-PROFILE-UPDATE-FREQUEN.applicabilityEvidence: Included in the module setup started by Brandon Dyches, Jessica Fertel. Review and exclude if unused.

CFG-LICENSING-STD-FISCAL-SEASON-DATES.title: Fiscal and season dates
CFG-LICENSING-STD-FISCAL-SEASON-DATES.steps: Configure and validate for Licensing. In Control Center > Settings > Configurations (/Settings/Configurations), review fiscal-year end month/day and season-year end month/day where used. Agree applicable year boundaries and verify a representative report or workflow across a boundary. Fiscal and season dates may differ. Mark Not applicable for this module if neither setting is used; do not change product-specific effective dates here.
CFG-LICENSING-STD-FISCAL-SEASON-DATES.applicabilityEvidence: Included in the module setup started by Brandon Dyches, Jessica Fertel. Review and exclude if unused.

CFG-LICENSING-STD-VOID-UNDO-RULES.title: Void and undo-void rules
CFG-LICENSING-STD-VOID-UNDO-RULES.steps: Configure and validate for Licensing. In Control Center > Settings > Configurations (/Settings/Configurations), review void level, void time limit and undo-void time limit where supported. Agree who performs each workflow and the permitted time windows; test allowed and expired-window cases. The configuration editor restricts void-level editing when VEMS is owned: confirm the supported behavior before changing this setting. Mark Not applicable if this module has no void workflow.
CFG-LICENSING-STD-VOID-UNDO-RULES.applicabilityEvidence: Included in the module setup started by Brandon Dyches, Jessica Fertel. Review and exclude if unused.

CFG-LICENSING-STD-USERS-ROLES.title: Users, roles and permissions

CFG-LICENSING-STD-USERS-ROLES.applicabilityEvidence: Included in the module setup started by Brandon Dyches, Jessica Fertel. Review and exclude if unused.
